title: Ex vivo Mimicry of Normal and Abnormal Human Hematopoiesis
protocol: Prepare a polymer solution of 5wt% in Dioxan.
Freeze the polymer solution to induce phase separation.
Sublimate the solvent to form PU scaffolds with pore sizes ranging from 100-250 mm and porosity between 90-95%.
Cut the scaffold disks into cubes of 0.5 x 0.5 x 0.5 mm.
Immerse the scaffolds in ethanol (70%) for 1 min.
Transfer the scaffolds into PBS and incubate for 20 min.
Centrifuge the scaffolds at 3630 x g for 10 min.
Add the protein solution to the scaffolds.
Centrifuge the scaffolds with the protein solution at 1420 x g for 20 min.
Centrifuge the scaffolds in PBS at 910 x g for 10 min to unblock surface pores.
Expose scaffolds to UV lamp for 8 minutes at 230 v, 50 Hz, and 0.14 A.
Immerse scaffolds in ethanol (70%) for 2 hours.
Wash the scaffolds twice with PBS.
Add Iscove's Modified Dulbecco Medium (IMDM) supplemented with 30% FBS and 1% P/S to the scaffolds.
Incubate the scaffolds at 37 °C in a humidified incubator with 5% CO2 for 3 days.
Extract human MNC from cord blood or leukemic bone marrow samples using Ficoll-Paque density gradient centrifugation for 35 min at 1500 rpm.
Resuspend MNC in IMDM containing 30% FBS and 1% P/S.
Seed 100 μl of MNC suspension (2 × 10^6 cells/scaffold) onto the scaffolds using a micro-pipette.
Incubate the seeded scaffolds at 37 °C under 5% CO₂ for 10 minutes to allow cells to settle into the scaffolds.
Top up each well with 1.5 ml of IMDM containing 30% FBS and 1% P/S and place the plates in the incubator at 37 °C and 5% CO₂ for the duration of the experiment.
Change media daily.
Remove one un-seeded and two seeded scaffolds from culture for MTS assay.
Place scaffolds in a clean new 24-well plate.
Add 1 ml of media and 200 μl of the MTS solution to each scaffold, incubate at 37 °C and 5% CO₂ for 3 hours.
Take 8 x 100 μl samples from the supernatant; place in a 96-well plate.
Measure absorbance at 490 nm using a microplate reader.
Remove scaffolds seeded with MNC from media for SEM analysis at different time points of culture.
Fix scaffolds with 2.5% PBS-buffered glutaraldehyde solution for 40 min at 4 °C.
Wash fixed scaffolds twice with PBS.
Dehydrate scaffolds in a graded series of ethanol (25, 50, 70, 80, 90, 95, and 100%), each for 10 minutes.
Dry scaffolds in an aseptic environment for 4 hours.
Section specimens and then sputter-coat them with gold in an argon atmosphere for 2 min prior to SEM evaluation.
Use an acceleration voltage of 20 kV.
Collect 2.0 x 10^4 cells/slide by aspirating the cells from the scaffold at different time points in culture.
Centrifuge the cells onto a glass slide for 3 min at 1500 rpm.
Stain the slides with Wright-Giemsa Stain Modified.
Observe the slides by using an optical microscope.
Wash scaffolds fixed with ethanol vapor (70%) overnight and then dry them.
Store scaffolds at -20°C until further analysis.
Section scaffolds into 30 μm-thick slices prior to visualization with a multiphoton microscope.
Wet sections with PBS.
Block the seeded scaffolds in PBS with 10% fetal bovine serum for 30 min at room temperature.
Incubate scaffolds overnight at 4°C in darkness with a 1:50 dilution of primary monoclonal antibody: mouse anti-human CD71.
Wash samples three times in PBS.
Stain samples with the secondary antibody: anti-mouse Alexa Fluor 488 for 1 h at room temperature in darkness.
Wash samples three times with PBS.
Observe samples with a confocal microscope using a water emission x60 objective lens.
Label cells of interest with corresponding immunofluorescence antibodies for detection.
Aspirate cells from the scaffold at different time points.
Centrifuge the aspirated cells.
Resuspend a cell pellet containing approximately 1x10^6 cells in 100 μl FC buffer (PBS + 0.1% sodium azide).
Add 10 μL of each antibody fluorescence dye to the resuspended cells.
Incubate the cells for 30 min at 4 °C.
Wash the cells twice with PBS.
Resuspend the washed cells in FC buffer.
Load the sample into the flow cytometer and stain with isotype control to set negativity of antibody expression.
Calibrate detection channels using flow cytometer controls.
Read the sample stained with three different antibodies.
Represent data using WinList software.
